description: This file defines the 'Cells' class in the PhpSpreadsheet library, managing a collection of cell objects within a worksheet. It handles cell storage, retrieval, deletion, sorting, and cache management, serving as a core component for worksheet data handling.

classes.name: Cells
classes.description: A class managing a collection of Cell objects within a Worksheet, with caching support, cell addition, deletion, sorting, and collection cloning functionalities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a Cells collection with a parent Worksheet and cache interface.

methods.name: getParent
methods.description: Returns the parent Worksheet object.

methods.name: has
methods.description: Checks if a cell exists at a given coordinate.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the cell at its current coordinate.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a cell from cache by its coordinate.

methods.name: getCoordinates
methods.description: Returns all cell coordinates in the collection.

methods.name: getSortedCoordinates
methods.description: Returns all cell coordinates sorted by their position.

methods.name: getCurrentCoordinate
methods.description: Returns the coordinate of the currently active cell.

methods.name: getCurrentColumn
methods.description: Returns the column of the currently active cell.

methods.name: getCurrentRow
methods.description: Returns the row of the currently active cell.

methods.name: getHighestRowAndColumn
methods.description: Gets the highest used row and column in the collection.

methods.name: getHighestColumn
methods.description: Returns the highest column name, optionally for a specific row.

methods.name: getHighestRow
methods.description: Returns the highest row number, optionally for a specific column.

methods.name: getUniqueID
methods.description: Generates a unique identifier for cache referencing.

methods.name: cloneCellCollection
methods.description: Clones the entire cell collection for a different worksheet.

methods.name: removeRow
methods.description: Removes all cells in a specified row.

methods.name: removeColumn
methods.description: Removes all cells in a specified column.

methods.name: storeCurrentCell
methods.description: Stores the current active cell in cache if dirty.

methods.name: destructIfNeeded
methods.description: Helper to destruct collection and throw exception if needed.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds or updates a cell at a specific coordinate.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a cell at a specific coordinate, from cache if available.

methods.name: unsetWorksheetCells
methods.description: Clears all cell data and detaches the collection from parent worksheet.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Cleans up cache entries for all stored cells.

methods.name: getAllCacheKeys
methods.description: Generator yielding all cache keys related to current cells.
